text:
Nora C.: quick heads-up: opened PR to update model catalog for the new q4/q8 builds, add migration notes and fix a few SDK snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5150
Liam S.: thanks. can you add exact instance/precision to the perf table (a100-40gb / fp16, a100-40gb / q8)? customers want repro details.
Nora C.: adding an "instance / precision" column and linking raw CSV. Also adding one-line limits: max seq 4096, recommended batch <=16.
Yara D.: spotted an old snippet using `client.generate()` — CI will break. I pushed a micro-commit switching to `client.text.generate()` and added SNIPPET_START/END markers.
ci-bot: docs build failed on branch nora/quantized-updates - missing snippet marker `SNIPPET_START:cli-q` in model-card/aether-7b.md.
Nora C.: adding CLI snippet now (old -> new) and fixing relative links broken by a file move.
Liam S.: for the compatibility table, let's be conservative: "Quantized variants: streaming limited; function-calls partial; long-context KV experimental." Also add a note recommending pinning variants with `@q8-YYYY-MM-DD` to avoid silent changes.
Yara D.: reworded slightly for clarity and pushed.
docs-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/aether-7b (branch: nora/quantized-updates)
ci-bot: build passed (job #2578).
Nora C.: merging after bench CSV attached. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Liam S.: attached CSV and final median p95 numbers, merging now.
Nora C.: merged 389 closing thread.
